Identifiers > App ID > Capability Requests > 'View Requests (n)' / status button opens the Request History modal with this call.

A POST that only reads: tool.DevSiteIsRead lists it by path. Run live on 2026-11-23 after a request was sent through Apple's form: it answered that request (requestId as on the form's thank-you page, status Submitted) and the capability's featureRequestCount stayed 1.

It does not file a request: the Request control is a plain link to the capability's attributes.requestFormUrl (a developer.apple.com/contact/request/... form). No call in the site's code submits a capability request.
note is Apple's note on the request ('Note From Apple'); status Approved is shown as Assigned. The team id goes into data.attributes.teamId (the read tool adds it).
